title: Utility Order for Parish Water Company, Inc., ex parte. — Order No. U-37904 accepts the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on September 17, 2026. Commission consideration occurred at the October 22, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                                 ORDER NUMBER U-37904

                     PARISH WATER COMPANY, INC., EX PARTE.

Docket No. U-37904, In re: Request for extension and modification of Formula Rate Plan.

               (Decided at the October 22, 2026 Business and Executive Session.)


                                            ORDER

OVERVIEW AND PROCEDURAL HISTORY
       On April 17, 2026, Parish Water Company, Inc. (“Parish” or the “Company”) filed an

application with the Louisiana Public Service Commission (“LPSC” or the “Commission”) for

approval of a renewal and modification of Parish’s Formula Rate Plan (“FRP”) for an additional

three-year term. Notice of this proceeding was published in the Commission’s Official Bulletin

#1374, dated April 24, 2026, with a fifteen-day intervention period. No interventions were

received.

       Parish proposed an extension of the current FRP for an additional three-year term, effective

with the Company’s December 31, 2025 test year and extending through the December 31, 2028

test year. The proposed extension would maintain the current midpoint rate of return on equity

(“ROE”) of 9.50% with an earnings bandwidth based on a calculated ROE lower limit of 9.00%

and an upper limit of 10.00%. However, Parish requested substantive and non-substantive

modifications to the FRP. These changes included in the Company’s request to extend the FRP

from December 31, 2025 through December 31, 2028 is an adjustment to review and effective

dates with May 1 being Staff’s deadline to review Parish’s annual filing, June 1 deadline for

response from Parish and an effective date of July 1

       On August 28, 2026, Staff filed its Staff Report and Recommendation with Direct

Testimony from Commission Staff witness Ms. Chassitty Williams. On September 9, 2026, Parish

filed a correspondence accepting Staff’s Recommendation. Staff recommended that the

Commission grants Parish’s request to extend and modify the Company’s current FRP for an

additional three-year term. The extension will include FRP Filing Years 2026, 2027, and 2028.

Staff also recommended the Company’s FRP to include modifications to allow Parish to include

extraordinary costs to allow recovery only in extraordinary circumstances, and to allow the

Company to propose new and/or modified rate schedules subject to Commission review and

approval. Staff did not recommend Parish’s requested modification to include additional rate base


                                                                              Order No. U-37904
                                                                                         Page 1
 adjustments to include projects that are in-use and useful during the FRP Filing Year. Staff’s

recommendation does not include any changes to Parish’s current FRP requirements including its

currently authorized Return on Equity (“ROE”) of 9.50%. After completion of discovery and

submission of testimony, Parish and Commission Staff reached an agreement and executed an

Uncontested Stipulated Settlement (“Settlement”) which was filed as a part Joint Motion of Parish

Water Company, Inc. and LPSC Staff to Schedule Hearing on Uncontested Stipulated Settlement

(“Joint Motion”) of on September 17, 2026.



COMMISSION AUTHORITY
       The Commission exercises jurisdiction over public utilities in Louisiana pursuant to Article
IV, Section 21(B) of the Louisiana Constitution, which provides the following:


              The commission shall regulate all common carriers and public
              utilities and have such other regulatory authority as provided by
              law. It shall adopt and enforce reasonable rules, regulations,
              and procedures necessary for the discharge of its duties, and shall
              have other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.


STIPULATED SETTLEMENT

       On September 17, 2026, Parish and Commission Staff, pursuant to Rule 6 of the

Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, filed a Joint Motion including Uncontested

Stipulated Settlement Term Sheet, Settlement Testimony from Chassitty Williams for Staff, and

Settlement Testimony from Roger A. Simmons on behalf of Parish. A hearing on the Settlement

was held before Administrative Law Judge (“ALJ”) Guillot on October 7, 2026. At the hearing,

Staff and Parish introduced testimony and documentary evidence in support of the settlement. ALJ

Guillot issued Report of Proceedings and Submission of Stipulation for Consideration by

Commissioners on October 8, 2026. The Settlement resolves all issues in this proceeding.

Terms of the Stipulated Settlement are:

       1.     Parish shall be authorized to renew its Formula Rate Plan (“FRP”) for an additional

              three-year (3-year) term encompassing the test years ending December 31, 2026;

              December 31, 2027; and December 31, 2028, with the following modifications:

              a. The following procedural deadlines shall apply to Parish’s FRP:

                      i. March 1: Parish’s deadline to file its FRP Annual Report.

                      ii. June 1: Staff’s deadline to file its Staff Report and Recommendation.


                                                                              Order No. U-37904
                                                                                         Page 2
                      iii. July 1: Parish’s deadline to file its Response to the Staff Report and

                         Recommendation.

                     iv. July 1: Adjusted rates may be implemented.

              b. Extraordinary Cost/Revenue Changes – Parish shall submit proper

                 documentation for all extraordinary cost or revenue changes occurring during

                 each FRP filing year.

              c. Special Rate Filings – Parish may propose new or modified rate schedules or

                 riders; however, all such rate schedules or riders are subject to Commission

                 review and approval.

       2.     Within thirty (30) days after the issuance of an order in this proceeding, Parish shall

              file into the record of this proceeding new or revised tariff pages reflecting the

              Commission’s action and shall submit a copy of the same to the Commission’s

              Utilities Division.

       3.     Parish shall file with the Commission a full base rate case no later than the deadline

              for filing its 2028 test year FRP Annual Report.

       4.     The order issued in this proceeding shall carry no precedential weight.



COMMISSION CONSIDERATION
       This matter was considered at the Commission’s October 22, 2026 Business and Executive

Session. On motion of Chairman Skrmetta, seconded by Commissioner Lewis, and unanimously

adopted, the Commission voted to accept the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the

record on September 17, 2026.




                             {This space intentionally left blank}




                                                                               Order No. U-37904
                                                                                          Page 3
 THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED:
       The Commission accepts the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on
September 17, 2026.


This order is effective immediately




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
November 20, 2026
